tldr: 台股高檔震盪，法人看第四季重回獲利驅動，被動元件成資金焦點。
鴻海等台廠遭美國337調查，格羅方德砸11億歐元擴建德國廠搶攻實體AI。
避險資金湧入貨幣市場基金達1538億美元，銅價逼近新高、12檔台股ETF規模創高。

items.title_zh: 台股Q4有望重回獲利驅動 資金轉進被動元件
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks seen returning to profit-driven gains in Q4 as capital rotates
items.summary_zh: 安聯投信指出，台股近期在美國利率政策、債券殖利率波動及地緣風險干擾下高檔震盪，上攻5萬點仍須整理。隨不確定因素逐步消化，第四季焦點可望重回企業營收與獲利基本面，轉為獲利驅動行情。大型權值股走勢疲軟之際，被動元件因AI伺服器與高效能運算推升高階MLCC、晶片電阻需求，加上旺季備貨與車用滲透提升，再現漲價題材而吸引資金青睞。
items.summary_en: Allianz says Taiwan's market is consolidating at high levels, rattled by US rate policy, bond-yield swings and geopolitical risk, leaving the 50,000-point mark out of reach for now. As these uncertainties clear, Q4 focus should shift back to corporate revenue, earnings and fundamentals. With large-cap weights soft, passive-component names are drawing funds as AI servers and HPC lift demand for high-end MLCCs and chip resistors, reviving price-hike themes.

items.title_zh: 電子五哥Q3股價三漲兩跌 伺服器帶動營收創高
items.title_en: Taiwan's "big five" contract makers post record Q3 revenue on server demand
items.summary_zh: 第三季電子五哥股價呈三漲兩跌，緯創漲16.4%表現最佳，和碩、仁寶上漲，廣達、英業達下跌；三大法人同步加碼五檔，以緯創買超逾16萬張最多。受惠伺服器業務，廣達、緯創單季營收分別突破1.16與1.15兆元，英業達、和碩亦創新高。廣達新世代伺服器第三季底試產，第四季開始小量出貨，營運動能延續。
items.summary_en: Among the five major electronics assemblers, Wistron, Pegatron and Compal rose in Q3 while Quanta and Inventec fell, a three-up, two-down split; Wistron led with a 16.4% gain. Institutions net-bought all five. Server business drove record or multi-quarter-high single-quarter revenue, with Quanta and Wistron both topping NT$1.1 trillion, as next-gen server products ramp toward small-volume Q4 shipments.

items.title_zh: 鴻海等台廠遭美國337專利調查 強調出貨正常
items.title_en: Foxconn and Taiwan peers named in US ITC Section 337 patent probe
items.summary_zh: 美國國際貿易委員會10月9日就電源模組廠Vicor的專利侵權主張，正式啟動337調查（編號337-TA-1526），台達電、鴻海、廣達等多家台廠及關係企業被列被調查方，範圍涵蓋特定垂直供電系統及搭載該系統的運算系統。鴻海聲明指出，初步評估未對生產營運、產品出貨及客戶合作造成重大影響，營運維持正常，已組成團隊因應，並持續與客戶、供應鏈夥伴溝通。
items.summary_en: The USITC on Oct 9 launched a Section 337 investigation (No. 337-TA-1526) over patent-infringement claims by US power-module maker Vicor, naming Delta Electronics, Foxconn, Quanta and affiliates as respondents. The probe covers certain vertical power-delivery systems and computing systems that use them. Foxconn said an initial review found no material impact on production, shipments or customer cooperation, operations remain normal, and it has formed a team to respond.

items.title_zh: 格羅方德砸11億歐元擴建德國晶圓廠 搶攻實體AI
items.title_en: GlobalFoundries to invest €1.1bn expanding its Dresden fab for "physical AI"
items.summary_zh: 晶圓代工廠格羅方德宣布德國德勒斯登SPRINT晶圓廠擴建計畫封頂，總投資11億歐元，並推出新一代FD-SOI平台FDX Fusion，鎖定機器人、智慧汽車與工業自動化。隨AI從雲端延伸至實體設備，晶片需求轉向低功耗、即時反應與感測整合。擴建後300毫米廠預計2028年底完成，年產能逾百萬片，可望成為歐洲最大晶圓代工基地，強化歐洲在地製造布局。
items.summary_en: GlobalFoundries topped out the SPRINT expansion of its Dresden, Germany fab—a €1.1 billion project—and unveiled its FDX Fusion FD-SOI platform targeting robotics, smart vehicles and industrial automation. As AI spreads from cloud data centers to physical devices, chip demand shifts toward low power, real-time response and sensor integration. Due by end-2028, the 300mm site will exceed one million wafers a year, becoming Europe's largest foundry base.

items.title_zh: 資金湧向避險 全球貨幣市場基金單周吸金1538億美元
items.title_en: Money-market funds pull in $153.8bn as investors flee to safety
items.summary_zh: 美債殖利率攀高、油價居高加深通膨疑慮，促使資金轉向避險。LSEG Lipper數據顯示，截至10月7日當周，全球貨幣市場基金淨流入1,538.1億美元，創5月以來最多；美國股票基金則轉為失血51.1億美元。美國10年期公債殖利率升抵5.3645%，創2002年以來新高，壓抑市場情緒，投資人在標普500創高後獲利了結，反映資金在股債間的避險輪動。
items.summary_en: With global bond selling intensifying, US Treasury yields climbing and oil elevated, inflation worries drove cash into havens. LSEG Lipper data show global money-market funds took in $153.81bn in the week to Oct 7, the most since early May, while US equity funds saw $5.11bn of outflows. The US 10-year yield hit 5.3645%, a 2002 high, pressuring sentiment and prompting profit-taking after the S&P 500's record.

items.title_zh: 台新新光金獨家贊助台北101國慶展演
items.title_en: Taishin Shin Kong Financial sponsors Taipei 101 National Day show for a second year
items.summary_zh: 台新新光金控獨家贊助的台北101國慶展演登場，以「Onward Taiwan 一起點亮台灣」為主題，結合無人機、大樓煙火及雷射燈光，長達14分鐘。總經理林維俊表示，能連續兩年獨家贊助深感榮幸。對金控業者而言，透過指標性公眾活動與吉祥物行銷強化品牌能見度，是深耕零售客群、提升集團形象的重要策略，也反映新光台新整併後品牌整合的推進。
items.summary_en: Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding exclusively sponsored the 14-minute Taipei 101 National Day display, themed "Onward Taiwan," combining drones, building fireworks and laser effects. President Lin Wei-jun said the group was honored to back the event for a second straight year. The high-profile cultural sponsorship shows how Taiwan's financial-holding firms use marquee public events to build brand visibility among retail customers after sector consolidation.

items.title_zh: 台股ETF逆勢壯大 12檔規模創高、00927今年翻倍居冠
items.title_en: Twelve Taiwan equity ETFs hit record size even as the index pulls back
items.summary_zh: 大盤創高後拉回整理，仍有12檔台股ETF規模逆勢創高，以市值型與高息型為主，包括群益半導體收益00927、國泰永續高股息00878、元大高股息0056。以今年以來含息績效計，00927上漲107.36%、績效翻倍居冠，成分股橫跨IC設計、晶圓代工與封測，兼具半導體成長與高息兩大主題。法人指出，ETF波動相對個股低，是盤面震盪時國人偏好的配置工具。
items.summary_en: After the broad market set highs and retreated, 12 Taiwan-listed ETFs still reached record assets, led by market-cap and high-dividend products such as Capital TIP Semiconductor Income (00927), Cathay Sustainability High Dividend (00878) and Yuanta High Dividend (0056). By total return this year, 00927 leads with a 107.36% gain, more than doubling. Its holdings span the semiconductor supply chain while pairing growth with high-yield names.

items.title_zh: 銅價逼近歷史高點 瑞銀、德銀示警供應缺口延續
items.title_en: Copper nears record highs as UBS and Deutsche Bank flag a lasting supply gap
items.summary_zh: 倫敦銅期貨上週五收報每公噸約14,622美元，逼近歷史高點。瑞銀、摩根大通與德意志銀行接連示警，電氣化與資料中心建設帶動需求，加上礦場罷工與全球庫存偏低，恐加劇供需失衡。瑞銀視銅為最具信心的大宗商品投資主題之一，預期供應缺口將延續至2030年代初；德銀喊價2.2萬美元。對高資產配置而言，銅等實物資產的結構性多頭題材值得留意。
items.summary_en: LME copper closed Friday near all-time highs at about $14,622 a tonne. UBS, JPMorgan and Deutsche Bank warned that demand from electrification and data-center build-out, plus mine strikes and low inventories, could worsen the supply-demand imbalance. UBS calls copper one of its highest-conviction commodity themes and expects a global supply gap to persist into the early 2030s; Deutsche Bank set a $22,000 price target.
